newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Eregli sell-off attracts two bids.
newsitem.headline: Turk Eregli sell-off attracts two bids.

text.p: Two bids have been received for a 30-40 percent stake being offered in Turkey's leading flat steel producer Eregli Demir ve Celik Fabrikalari A.S., the Turkish Privatisation Administration (OIB) said on Tuesday.
"The period for placing bids in the tender for block sales expired on January 27, 1997 and bids were received from two investors," the OIB said in a statement.
The bids were made by Rumeli Metal Sanayii A.S. and a joint offer by a group of investors from Eregli and an investment company in the town of Zonguldak, the statement said.
The government holds a 51.66 percent stake in Eregli.
